description: Scenarios for the AI assistant (DSO4), run on the demo data (the 5 eval_v1 jobs, the 12 synthetic candidates, the HR knowledge base). expected_tools: the first tool called must be one of them ([] = no tool needed, null = any). expect_any: the answer must contain at least one of these strings; expect_all: all of them; forbid: none of them (accents and case ignored). Expected candidates come from the silver labels of eval_v1 (grade 3 or 2 for the job) or from the synthetic profiles themselves.
